chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Indeed, those who are saved from among the men are few, and from among the women, even fewer and fewer.

key_terms.الرِّجَالِ: men, referring to the male members of the community
key_terms.النَّاجِيَ: the one who is saved or delivered from ruin
key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: women, referring to the female members of the community

ai.seo_question: How rare is salvation according to this hadith of the Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام states that true salvation is attained only by a small number of people. The wording emphasizes the rarity of spiritual success and serves as a serious moral warning within the context of conduct and accountability.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Indeed, those who are saved from among the men are few, and from among the women, even fewer and fewer."
